Hide cookies message Skip to main content About MI5: Official Secrets MI5: Official Secrets was a major exhibition that stepped inside the hidden world of MI5 and explored the extraordinary stories behind the security of a nation. It is now permanently closed . For the first time, MI5’s history was on display to the public, made possible through an unprecedented partnership between the Security Service and The National Archives. Visitors explored the ever-changing world of espionage and security threats through original case files, photographs and papers, alongside the real equipment used by spies and spy-catchers over MI5’s 115-year history. From counter-espionage and daring double-agents during the world wars, to chilling Cold War confessions and the counter-terrorism of recent times, this historic exhibition went behind the scenes of one of Britain’s most iconic institutions. Ciamarra heads the Office of Policy and Rulemaking (APL) where he will advise the Administrator on major policy questions, lead the development of the FAA’s policy agenda, lead rulemaking and deregulatory efforts, and oversee the FAA’s implementation of congressional reauthorization. APL drives the agency’s strategic planning and national aviation policy – including environmental and energy strategy, aviation activity forecasts, and economic analyses. Ciamarra came to the FAA from Southwest Airlines where he was Senior Federal Affairs Director. There he developed the federal legislative and regulatory strategy for the company on issues such as air traffic control, airport development, and transportation security. pages.text: Michael Harris II wins 2022 NL Rookie of Year; Spencer Strider runner-up Skip to Content ATLANTA -- As Michael Harris II and Spencer Strider shared adjoining lockers within Truist Park’s home clubhouse this year, they fed off each other’s youthful excitement and established themselves as two of the most impressive rookies baseball has seen in years. When this past season ended, it was presumed these two Braves would finish first and second in balloting for the Jackie Robinson National League Rookie of the Year Award. The only question was who would win. The answer was revealed on Monday night, when Harris was announced as the recipient of this year’s honor. • Rookie of the Year Award, all-time winners Harris is the ninth Braves player to be named NL Rookie of the Year and the first since Ronald Acuña Jr. in 2018. This was an honor the 21-year-old center fielder certainly didn’t anticipate when he began this season with Double-A Mississippi. Harris received 22 of the 30 first-place votes cast by members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America, and Strider received the remaining eight. This is the first time teammates have finished first and second in Rookie of the Year balloting since former Braves Craig Kimbrel and Freddie Freeman in 2011. • Full voting results “To get the award [that is named after] Jackie, it means a lot because he paved the way for players like me,” Harris said. “Just to be able to have an award named after him and actually win it … I don’t know. Michael Helmer Michael Helmer brings nearly a decade of Capitol Hill experience to his role as Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary for the U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation (CMEI). Most recently, Helmer served as legislative assistant to Senator Kevin Cramer of North Dakota, where he advised the Senator on energy, environmental, and trade issues. His congressional tenure also includes roles as a legislative director and professional committee staffer on the House Committee on Rules. Helmer previously served at the U.S. Department of Energy from 2019 to 2021 in the Office of Congressional and Intergovernmental Affairs. In his current capacity, he is responsible for providing executive leadership to advance CMEI’s strategic objectives, streamline internal operations, and ensure alignment with the administration’s policy goals and priorities. Close michaelIsADullGuy's Diary 南京新街口地块精细化更新日志 Posted by michaelIsADullGuy on 29 May 2026 in Chinese (China) (‪中文(中国大陆)‬) . 前言 新街口作为南京乃至华东地区最重要的商业核心之一，其 OSM 数据长期存在建筑轮廓粗糙、地下空间缺失、路径拓扑混乱等问题。为此，我启动了一项针对新街口地块的系统性精细化更新计划，并在此记录操作步骤与我所制定的制图标准，供社区参考与讨论。 一、建筑物轮廓与属性细化 所有建筑物的轮廓均参照最新卫星影像与实地核查进行重新描绘或修正，具体标准如下： 轮廓贴合建筑基底，避免过度简化或偏移； 补充 building:levels 、 height 、 name 、 start_date 等属性； 对于综合体建筑（如德基广场、金鹰国际），区分裙楼与塔楼，分别以 building 、 building:part 进行三维建模。 二、地下商业空间的划定 新街口地铁站（地铁1号线×2号线换乘）向四周延伸出大量地下通道，直接连通周边各大商场的负一层。凡与地铁站地下通道 直接联通 的商场负一层空间，均按以下标准标注为地下建筑区域： 使用 location=underground 或 layer=-1 标记相关区域； 地下商业区域的范围多边形参照实际通道出入口与商业空间边界绘制； 与地铁站直接相连的通道本身，以 tunnel=yes + layer=-1 的 highway=footway 表示； 暂不确定是否联通的区域，暂以 fixme=需核实地下联通情况 标注，留待后续实地核查。 目前已完成地下空间划定的区域包括： 新街口百货商店 B1、金陵中环 B1 待补充区域： 金鹰国际购物中心 B1、德基广场 B1、中央商场 B1、南京国际金融中心 B1 等。 三、路径拓扑标准 这是本次更新中最容易出错的部分。为确保路网拓扑的清洁与导航规划的准确性，我制定了以下强制性规则： 3.1 各类道路不得混接 在主要路口， 行人路径（ highway=footway/pedestrian ）、自行车道（ highway=cycleway ）、机动车道（ highway=primary 等） 三者之间，原则上不建议建立直接连接节点，除非现实中存在明确的路权交汇点（如行人过街横道节点）。 3.2 跨图层要素禁止连接 任何两个 不属于同一 layer 值 的路径要素， 不得出现共享连接节点 ，以下情况除外： 允许连接的要素 说明 highway=steps 阶梯，连接不同楼层/层级 含 conveying=yes 的 highway=footway 自动扶梯 highway=elevator 电梯 除上述垂直交通要素外，地面路径与地下路径 一律不得出现连接点 。 此规则同样适用于在导航计算中看似”无害”的连接（例如建筑物轮廓与步行道路相切）。只要两个要素不属于同一图层，路径要素与非路径要素之间同样须保持几何上的独立性，仅在视觉上相邻即可。同一图层内的要素按正常规则连接，不受此限制。 如有异议或建议，欢迎在变更集评论或讨论页留言。 Happy mapping! 🗺️ Discussion Leave a comment Log in to leave a comment

pages.text: Michelangelo (1475 - 1564) | National Gallery, London Skip to main content Painter, on panel and in fresco , sculptor and architect, writer of sonnets, Michelangelo Buonarroti was the first artist recognised by contemporaries as a genius. Hero of the High Renaissance . He was the only artist of whom it was claimed in his lifetime that he surpassed Antiquity . He was born in Caprese in the 1470s and trained first as a painter with Ghirlandaio , and then as a sculptor under the patronage of Lorenzo de' Medici . In 1496, already known as sculptor, he went to Rome, where he carved the 'Pietà' for St Peter's. Back in Florence in 1501 he began work on many sculptural and painterly projects most of which were left unfinished in 1505, when he was summoned to Rome to begin work on a sculpted tomb for Pope Julius II, a project that dogged him until 1545. From 1508 to 1512 he painted the vault of the Sistine Chapel with scenes from the Old Testament, from the Creation to the Story of Noah. Immediately celebrated, the Sistine Chapel ceiling, with its innumerable figures in complex, twisting poses and its exuberant use of colour, is the chief source of the Mannerist style. pages.text: Michelangelo and the Tomb that Tormented Him | National Geographic HISTORY & CULTURE Michelangelo and the Tomb that Tormented Him During his years in Rome, Michelangelo took on some of the Renaissance’s most important and difficult commissions—from the Sistine Chapel to St. Peter’s Basilica. But nothing burdened him more than the tomb of Pope Julius II. “Moses" by Michelangelo Created between 1513 and 1516, this sculpture became the centerpiece of Pope Julius II’s tomb when it was installed in 1545. Anna Serrano/Fototeca 9x12 By Eloi de Tera Published November 16, 2026 The warm torpor of summer still lingered in the long afternoons of September 1534, when momentous news reached Florence. Giulio de’ Medici, Pope Clement VII, had died on the 25th of that month, after allegedly eating poisonous mushrooms. The tomb of Giuliano de’ Medici, with figures “Night” and “Day,” was designed and sculpted by Michelangelo. Guido Cozzi/Fototeca 9x12 At the time, within the so-called New Sacristy of the Basilica of San Lorenzo in Florence (an architectural space conceived as a mausoleum for the Medici family), scaffolding was being erected under the watchful eye of Michelangelo Buonarroti. The artist, known to the world today as Michelangelo, was nearly 60 years old and had been commissioned to design the sacristy, which would mirror Filippo Brunelleschi’s Old Sacristy. But events overtook him. A few days earlier, he had left Florence for Rome, where he arrived on September 23, just two days before the pope’s death. pages.title: Michelangelo Used These Custom, Multi-Headed Brushes While Painting 'The Last Judgment' to Replicate His Intricate Sculpting Techniques
pages.description: While restoring the Sistine Chapel, researchers discovered wavy groupings of brushstrokes which indicated that the artist used the special brushes to create a distinct crosshatching pattern
pages.text: Michelangelo Used These Custom, Multi-Headed Brushes While Painting 'The Last Judgment' to Replicate His Intricate Sculpting Techniques Skip to main content Detail showing the hair of one of the figures around Christ in The Last Judgment , as example of the use of a multi-tipped brush Governatorato SCV – Direzione dei Musei e dei Beni Culturali This spring, the Vatican restored the Sistine Chapel for the first time in 30 years. Restorers worked for three months to remove layers of calcium lactate—a whitish salt from the dried sweat from millions of visitors and the plaster in the walls—that had settled onto Michelangelo ’s immaculate 16th-century murals. As experts climbed temporary scaffolding and applied distilled water and absorbent Japanese paper to clean away the grime, they got a rare, close-up view of Michelangelo’s vivid masterpieces. They noticed something unique about The Last Judgment , the massive mural located behind the chapel’s altar, as its original colors emerged. Michelangelo had painted with wavy brushstrokes that appeared to have moved in synchronization. “I initially saw that Michelangelo painted with parallel strokes, often perpendicular to each to give a cross-hatching effect,” Paolo Violini , the Vatican’s chief restorer, tells the London Times ’ Tom Kington. “Then I saw that when a stroke wobbled slightly, other strokes parallel to it had an identical wobble. That meant one thing: Michelangelo was using special brushes with multiple heads, each with a small brush on the end of it, allowing him to produce parallel strokes with one large brush.” Examp

pages.text: Michelangelo | The Entombment (or Christ being carried to his Tomb) | NG790 | National Gallery, London Skip to main content Michelangelo, 'The Entombment (or Christ being carried to his Tomb)', about 1500-1 The Entombment (or Christ being carried to his Tomb) Michelangelo Room 2 Framed About the work Overview In-depth Audio description Overview This is one of perhaps only three surviving panel paintings by the great Florentine artist Michelangelo. It shows Christ’s body being carried to his tomb. It was probably made for a funerary chapel in the church of S. Agostino, Rome – commissioned in 1500 and left unfinished when Michelangelo returned to Florence the following year. Saint John the Evangelist may be the figure on the left carrying Christ’s body on strips of winding cloth helped by one of the Three Marys. They carry him up a staircase to his tomb in the rocks. The man behind Christ is either Joseph of Arimathea or Nicodemus. Another of the Three Marys, possibly Mary Magdalene, sits on the ground. The space left empty on the right was probably intended for the kneeling figure of the Virgin Mary. The other female figure on the right is probably another of the Three Marys, Mary Salome. In-depth This unfinished painting shows Christ’s body being carried to his tomb in the rocks behind him. It is one of only three known surviving panel paintings by the great Florentine artist Michelangelo – the others are The Virgin and Child with Saint John and Angels (‘The Manchester Madonna’) and the Doni Tondo (Uffizi, Florence). pages.text: Michigan's Isle Royale National Park Is a camper's paradise | National Geographic National Geographic Traveller (UK) content straight to your inbox — sign up for our newsletter here TRAVEL Everything you should know about Isle Royale National Park Michigan’s remote and rugged Lake Superior archipelago—which encompasses nearly 450 islands—is a true Northwoods escape, ideal for hikers, wildlife lovers, and stargazers. In western Lake Superior, Isle Royale National Park is an archipelago comprised of over 400 smaller islands and rocky islets, including Siksiwit Island, Chippewa Harbor Islands, and Mott Island, the park’s summer headquarters on the south side of Rock Harbor Channel. Aaron Black-Schmidt, Tandem Stock By Amy S. Eckert Last updated March 31, 2026 • 13 min read Isle Royale National Park offers an unforgettable Lake Superior wilderness escape in Michigan . Despite its name, Isle Royale encompasses not merely its namesake island, but an archipelago of nearly 450 islands located 14 miles (22.5 km) from the nearest mainland. Once in the park, you’ll discover a landscape of rocky shoreline and basalt ridges covered with sugar maple, birch, and evergreen forest. The woods are carpeted with delicate wildflowers like bluebells, Canada Mayflowers, and lady’s slippers, and in late summer, you can harvest thimbleberries for snacking. If you’re lucky, you may spot moose, wolves, and aquatic birds along the park’s 165 miles (265 km) of hiking trails. How to roll back Microsoft Edge to a previous version Feedback Summarize this article for me This article describes how to roll back to a previous version of Microsoft Edge using the rollback feature. To learn more about this feature, watch Video: Microsoft Edge version rollback . Introduction to rollback Rollback lets you replace your Microsoft Edge browser version with an earlier version. This feature is designed to be a safety net for enterprises deploying Microsoft Edge. It provides a way to troubleshoot issues with Microsoft Edge. The benefits of rollback are the ability to revert to previous browser version easily and quickly. Rollback reduces the potential impact that a Microsoft Edge issue has on business operations. Before you begin It's important to understand how the rollback feature is installed in a Microsoft Edge environment. You can deploy rollback using two different methods: manually with an MSI or by using Microsoft Edge update and Group Policy. We also encourage using a selection of Group Policies for a smoother deployment. A critical Microsoft outage lasting more than 22 hours has raised questions about how heavily vital services rely on a handful of major tech firms. The disruption, which affected Microsoft 365 services such as Outlook, was caused by routine automated checks that took some servers offline, overloading the remaining ones with traffic. The recovery took nearly a full day while engineers gradually restored services, highlighting how embedded the tech giant's services are in modern society. Flora Hamilton, executive director of the Small Business Charter, said the outage was a "stark reminder" of how much firms "rely on digital systems" - like Microsoft Outlook - "to keep their operations running". "For many small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), access to email is fundamental to everything from communicating with customers and suppliers to generating income," she said. The disruption was not just confined to businesses, but also affected organisations and public institutions around the world. Around 430 million people globally use Microsoft 365, and issues were reported across more than 70 countries. A medida que los flujos migratorios se vuelven más complejos – en particular debido al aumento de los desplazamientos forzosos y de los movimientos migratorios mixtos –, la protección de los trabajadores migrantes y refugiados sigue siendo un elemento central del mandato de la OIT, consagrado en el preámbulo de su Constitución desde 1919. La mayor parte de la migración internacional está motivada por la búsqueda de trabajo decente y de medios de vida dignos. Si bien la migración puede brindar mejores salarios y oportunidades para el desarrollo de competencias, muchos trabajadores migrantes siguen excluidos de las protecciones laborales y son vulnerables a la discriminación y la explotación. Para las poblaciones desplazadas, el acceso al trabajo decente es un elemento esencial de las soluciones de desarrollo sostenible, ya que permite a los refugiados participar activamente en las economías y sociedades de las comunidades de acogida y contribuir a ellas. Se necesita cooperación internacional para formular políticas que maximicen los beneficios de la migración laboral y proporcionen trabajo decente para todos. I’ve been building Wandering Around , a free browser game in which you can walk around any town or city on Earth. The whole world comes from OpenStreetMap, so I’d like to share how it uses OSM data and ask this community for feedback. The game fetches the tiles around the player, decodes them in the browser, stitches buildings that are split across tile edges and turns everything back into OSM-style features with tags. He also serves as a guest host for NPR radio shows, including Weekend Edition and All Things Considered . He began covering election issues after the 2016 presidential election, and his work was cited in the Senate Intelligence Committee's report on Russian election interference.
